fields.description: Four-digit expiration year of the credit card (e.g., 2026).

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

CurrencyRate.description: Historical daily currency exchange rates between pairs of currencies, recording end-of-day and average rates

fields.name: EndOfDayRate

fields.name: ModifiedDate

CountryRegion.description: ISO 3166-1 country and region codes and names used for addresses and sales territories

StateProvince.description: State and province lookup table with ISO abbreviations, cross-referenced to country/region and optional sales territory

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

fields.description: Part of composite primary key. References the person, store, or vendor this address belongs to. Foreign key to BusinessEntity.

fields.name: AddressID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. References the physical address record. Foreign key to Address (Production.Address).

Person.description: All human beings involved with Adventure Works Cycles: customers (IN), employees (EM), sales persons (SP), vendor contacts (VC), store contacts (SC), and general contacts (GC). PersonType field distinguishes the role.

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: Primary key. Foreign key to BusinessEntity.BusinessEntityID. Shared identifier linking this person to any associated vendor, store, or employee record.

fields.name: PersonType
fields.description: Two-character code indicating the primary role: SC = Store Contact, IN = Individual (retail) customer, SP = Sales person, EM = Employee (non-sales), VC = Vendor contact, GC = General contact.

fields.name: NameStyle
fields.description: Controls name display order. 0 = Western style (Title FirstName MiddleName LastName Suffix). 1 = Eastern style (LastName FirstName) for cultures where family name comes first.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Optional courtesy title prefix (e.g., Mr., Ms., Mrs., Dr., Rev., Sir). Maximum 8 characters.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: Given (first) name of the person. Required field, maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name or initial of the person. Optional, maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Family (last) name of the person. Required field, maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: Suffix
fields.description: Optional generational or professional suffix (e.g., Jr., Sr., III, PhD). Maximum 10 characters.

fields.name: EmailPromotion
fields.description: Marketing opt-in level. 0 = No promotional emails. 1 = Opt-in to Adventure Works emails. 2 = Opt-in to emails from Adventure Works and selected partners.

fields.name: AdditionalContactInfo
fields.description: Supplementary contact information stored as XML (e.g., instant messaging handles, alternative phone numbers, social media profiles).

fields.name: Demographics
fields.description: Personal demographic data collected from online shoppers stored as XML (e.g., household income, education level, hobbies, commute distance). Used for sales analysis and personalisation.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: Primary key. Foreign key to Person.BusinessEntityID. One password record per person.

fields.name: PasswordHash
fields.description: PBKDF2/SHA1 derived password hash encoded as a Base64 string. Never the plaintext password. Maximum 128 characters.

fields.name: PasswordSalt
fields.description: Random cryptographic salt (10 characters) concatenated with the plaintext password before hashing, preventing rainbow-table attacks.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

EmailAddress.description: Email addresses for persons, supporting multiple addresses per person identified by EmailAddressID. Used for customer login, order confirmations, and marketing communications.

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to Person.BusinessEntityID. Identifies which person owns this email address.

fields.name: EmailAddressID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Auto-incrementing integer distinguishing multiple email addresses for the same person.

fields.name: EmailAddress
fields.description: The actual email address string (e.g., john.doe@adventure-works.com). Used for login authentication and all outbound communications. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

PersonPhone.description: Phone numbers associated with persons, categorised by phone number type (Cell, Home, Work). A person may have multiple phone numbers of different types.

PersonCreditCard.description: Cross-reference table linking persons to their registered credit cards. A person may register multiple credit cards.

fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SalesPerson.description: Sales representatives employed by Adventure Works Cycles, with commission rate, annual sales quota, year-to-date sales, and territory assignment

fields.description: Primary key. Foreign key to HumanResources.Employee (via BusinessEntityID). Links this sales record to the employee and person records.

fields.name: TerritoryID
fields.description: Sales territory currently assigned to this sales person. Foreign key to SalesTerritory. Nullable if not yet assigned.

fields.name: SalesQuota

fields.name: Bonus

fields.name: CommissionPct
fields.description: Commission percentage rate earned per sale (e.g., 0.012 = 1.2%). Used to calculate commission payable from sales order revenue.

fields.name: SalesYTD
fields.description: Cumulative sales revenue generated by this sales person in the current fiscal year, in USD.

fields.name: SalesLastYear
fields.description: Total sales revenue generated by this sales person in the previous fiscal year, in USD.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the customer account.

fields.name: PersonID
fields.description: Foreign key to Person.BusinessEntityID. Populated for individual (retail) customers. NULL for store (B2B) customers.

fields.name: AccountNumber

fields.name: Diagram
fields.description: Assembly or technical illustration stored as XML. Contains structured diagram data for bicycle components used in service manuals and manufacturing instructions.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

Location.description: Manufacturing work center locations within the Adventure Works Cycles plant, each with a cost rate per hour and available capacity in hours

fields.name: LocationID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing small integer uniquely identifying the work center location.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Descriptive name of the manufacturing work center (e.g., Tool Crib, Paint, Final Assembly, Subcomponent Storage). Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: CostRate
fields.description: Standard hourly labour and overhead cost for this work center in USD (e.g., 0.00 for storage, 22.50 for machining). Used in work order cost calculations.

fields.name: Availability

ProductSubcategory.description: Product sub-categories nested under a top-level ProductCategory (e.g., Mountain Bikes, Road Bikes, Touring Bikes under Bikes; Handlebars, Brakes, Wheels under Components)

fields.description: Subcategory name (e.g., Mountain Bikes, Road Bikes, Helmets, Jerseys, Gloves, Pedals, Wheels). Unique within the table.

fields.name: rowguid

ProductModel.description: Product model definitions that group related product variants. Optionally contains XML manufacturing instructions (CatalogDescription) and catalog descriptions (Instructions).

fields.name: ProductModelID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the product model.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Model name shared by all product variants in this group (e.g., Mountain-100, Road-150, Touring-1000). Unique within the table. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: CatalogDescription
fields.description: Detailed product catalog content stored as XML, including marketing copy, product highlights, and technical specifications used in the online store.

fields.name: Instructions
fields.description: Step-by-step manufacturing assembly instructions stored as XML. Referenced by work orders during production.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

ProductDescription.description: Product descriptions per language, AI-enhanced to support up to 2000 characters of rich content. Includes DescriptionEmbedding (VECTOR(1536), text-embedding-3-small model) for semantic similarity search across languages.

fields.name: ProductDescriptionID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the product description record.

fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to ProductModel.ProductModelID. Identifies which product model this description belongs to.

fields.name: CultureID

ProductSearch.description: Read-only view for AI-powered semantic product search. Joins Product, ProductModel, ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture, ProductDescription, and ProductName to expose per-language search data including DescriptionEmbedding and ProductNameEmbedding (both VECTOR(1536), text-embedding-3-small) for vector similarity search. Only finished goods are included.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Part of composite key. Identifier of the product (finished goods only). Foreign key to Product.ProductID.

fields.name: ProductDescriptionID
fields.description: Part of composite key. Identifier of the localised description record for this product and culture combination. Foreign key to ProductDescription.ProductDescriptionID.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Product name as stored in Production.Product for the default locale.

fields.name: ProductName
fields.description: Culture-specific product name translation from Production.ProductName for the row's CultureID. Falls back to the base product name if no translation exists.

fields.name: ProductDescription
fields.description: Culture-specific product description text from ProductDescription.Description for the row's CultureID.

fields.name: CultureID
fields.description: Culture/language code for this row (e.g., en, fr, ar). Joins to Culture.CultureID.

fields.name: DescriptionEmbedding
fields.description: 1536-dimensional vector embedding of ProductDescription, generated with text-embedding-3-small. Used for semantic similarity search queries against product descriptions.

fields.name: ProductNameEmbedding
fields.description: 1536-dimensional vector embedding of the culture-specific ProductName, generated with text-embedding-3-small. Used for semantic name-based product discovery.

ProductModelIllustration.description: Cross-reference table linking product models to their assembly or technical illustration diagrams

fields.name: ProductModelID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to ProductModel.ProductModelID. Identifies which product model this illustration is associated with.

fields.name: IllustrationID

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

Product.description: Products manufactured or sold by Adventure Works Cycles. Includes pricing (ListPrice, StandardCost), dimensions (Size, Weight), inventory status (FinishedGoodsFlag, MakeFlag), and style attributes. AI-enhanced: Color field extended to 256 characters for descriptive AI-generated colour names.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the product SKU.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Product name displayed in the storefront and used in reports (e.g., Mountain-100 Silver, 38). Must be unique across all products. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: ProductNumber
fields.description: Manufacturer part number in the format [ProductLine]-[Abbreviation]-[Size/Style] (e.g., BK-M18S-38 for a Mountain bike, size 38, silver). Unique within the table.

fields.name: MakeFlag
fields.description: 0 = Product is purchased from a vendor. 1 = Product is manufactured in-house. Drives whether a work order or purchase order is created.

fields.name: FinishedGoodsFlag
fields.description: 0 = Product is a sub-component or raw material, not sold directly. 1 = Product is a finished good available for sale on the storefront.

fields.name: Color
fields.description: Product colour. AI-enhanced field extended to 256 characters to hold descriptive AI-generated colour names (e.g., Gloss Midnight Black, Pearl Metallic Silver) rather than simple labels. Nullable for components with no colour attribute.

fields.name: SafetyStockLevel
fields.description: Minimum on-hand inventory quantity that must be maintained. Triggers a reorder when stock falls below this level.

fields.name: ReorderPoint
fields.description: Inventory level at which a purchase order or work order should be created to replenish stock. Must be greater than or equal to SafetyStockLevel.

fields.name: StandardCost
fields.description: Internal standard manufacturing or purchase cost per unit in USD. Used for cost-of-goods-sold calculations and profitability reporting.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description: Recommended retail selling price per unit in USD displayed on the storefront. A value of 0.00 indicates the product is not currently for sale.

fields.name: Size
fields.description: Physical size designation (e.g., S, M, L, XL, 38, 42, 58). Unit of measure is given by SizeUnitMeasureCode. Nullable for products without a size dimension.

fields.name: SizeUnitMeasureCode
fields.description: Unit of measure for the Size value (e.g., CM for centimetres, IN for inches). Foreign key to UnitMeasure.UnitMeasureCode. Nullable when Size is null.

fields.name: WeightUnitMeasureCode
fields.description: Unit of measure for the Weight value (e.g., LB for pounds, G for grams). Foreign key to UnitMeasure.UnitMeasureCode. Nullable when Weight is null.

fields.name: Weight
fields.description: Product weight in the unit specified by WeightUnitMeasureCode. Nullable for products where weight is not tracked.

fields.name: DaysToManufacture
fields.description: Number of calendar days required to manufacture one unit of this product. Used for production scheduling and lead-time calculations.

fields.name: ProductLine
fields.description: Two-character product line code: R = Road, M = Mountain, T = Touring, S = Standard. Nullable for accessories and components not assigned to a specific line.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Two-character quality/price class: H = High, M = Medium, L = Low. Used to segment products within a product line for pricing and reporting.

fields.name: Style

fields.name: StandardCost

ProductListPriceHistory.description: Historical list (retail) price of products over time, tracking all price changes with StartDate and EndDate effective ranges

fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the product whose price history is recorded.

fields.name: StartDate

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Date on which this price was superseded. NULL means this is the currently active list price.

fields.name: ListPrice

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

ProductInventory.description: Current on-hand quantity of each product held at each manufacturing or warehouse location, including bin and shelf identifiers

fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the product held in inventory.

fields.name: LocationID

fields.name: Shelf
fields.description: Identifier for the storage shelf within the location (e.g., A, B, C). Maximum 10 characters.

fields.name: Bin
fields.description: Numeric identifier for the storage bin on the shelf (0–99). Combined with Shelf provides the precise storage position.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Current on-hand unit count for this product at this location. Used to determine IsInStock status and drive reorder triggers.

fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SpecialOffer.description: Discount offers and promotional campaigns applied to products. Types include No Discount (baseline), Volume Discount, Seasonal Discount, Excess Inventory, and Mountain-100 Clearance. Discount is stored as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.10 = 10%).

fields.name: SpecialOfferID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the special offer. SpecialOfferID = 1 is the baseline 'No Discount' record applied to all standard order lines.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Human-readable name describing the promotion (e.g., No Discount, Volume Discount 11 to 14, Mountain-100 Clearance Sale). Maximum 255 characters.

fields.name: DiscountPct
fields.description: Discount amount expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.00 = no discount, 0.10 = 10%, 0.40 = 40%). Applied to the UnitPrice on qualifying sales order lines.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Promotion type category (e.g., No Discount, Volume Discount, Seasonal Discount, Excess Inventory, Discontinued Product). Used for promotional reporting.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Customer segment the offer targets: Customer (retail) or Reseller (B2B store).

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Date on which the promotion becomes active and eligible to be applied to new sales orders.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Date after which the promotion can no longer be applied to new orders.

fields.name: MinQty
fields.description: Minimum order quantity of the qualifying product required to activate this discount. 0 means no minimum.

fields.name: MaxQty
fields.description: Maximum order quantity eligible for this discount. NULL means there is no upper limit.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SpecialOfferProduct.description: Cross-reference table restricting which products qualify for each special offer. A product must appear here to receive a promotion's discount on a sales order line.

fields.name: SpecialOfferID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to SpecialOffer.SpecialOfferID. Identifies the promotion being linked to a product.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the product that qualifies for the promotion.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SalesOrderHeader.description: Summary record for each customer sales order, capturing billing and shipping addresses, payment method, ship method, currency, order and ship dates, and financial totals (SubTotal, TaxAmt, Freight, TotalDue). Status codes: 1=In process, 2=Approved, 3=Backordered, 4=Rejected, 5=Shipped, 6=Cancelled.

fields.name: SalesOrderID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the sales order.

fields.name: RevisionNumber
fields.description: Incremental version counter tracking how many times this order has been modified since creation. Starts at 0.

fields.name: OrderDate
fields.description: Date and time the sales order was created. Defaults to the current date/time at insertion.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: Contractual date by which the order must be delivered to the customer.

fields.name: ShipDate
fields.description: Date on which the order was actually shipped. NULL until the order is dispatched.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Current order lifecycle status. 1 = In process, 2 = Approved, 3 = Backordered, 4 = Rejected, 5 = Shipped, 6 = Cancelled.

fields.name: OnlineOrderFlag
fields.description: 0 = Order was placed by a sales representative. 1 = Order was placed online by the customer through the e-commerce storefront.

fields.name: SalesOrderNumber
fields.description: Computed unique order reference number in the format SO + zero-padded SalesOrderID (e.g., SO43659). Displayed on order confirmation emails and invoices.

fields.name: PurchaseOrderNumber
fields.description: Customer's own purchase order reference number, provided at time of order for B2B reconciliation. Nullable for retail/online orders.

fields.name: AccountNumber
fields.description: Financial accounting reference number for the order, computed from the customer's AccountNumber. Used for ERP integration.

fields.name: CustomerID
fields.description: Foreign key to Customer.CustomerID. Identifies the customer who placed this order.

fields.name: SalesPersonID
fields.description: Foreign key to SalesPerson.BusinessEntityID. Sales representative who created this order. NULL for online orders placed without an assigned rep.

fields.name: TerritoryID
fields.description: Sales territory in which this order was placed. Foreign key to SalesTerritory.TerritoryID. Used for territory revenue reporting.

fields.name: BillToAddressID
fields.description: Address to which the invoice should be sent. Foreign key to Person.Address.AddressID.

fields.name: ShipToAddressID
fields.description: Address to which the order should be shipped. Foreign key to Person.Address.AddressID.

fields.name: ShipMethodID
fields.description: Shipping carrier and service selected for this order. Foreign key to ShipMethod.ShipMethodID.

fields.name: CreditCardID
fields.description: Credit card used to pay for this order. Foreign key to CreditCard.CreditCardID. Nullable when payment is by purchase order or other method.

fields.name: CreditCardApprovalCode
fields.description: Authorisation code returned by the card payment processor at time of purchase. Maximum 15 characters. Nullable for non-card orders.

fields.name: CurrencyRateID
fields.description: Exchange rate record used to convert the order total to a foreign currency. Foreign key to CurrencyRate.CurrencyRateID. NULL for USD orders.

fields.name: SubTotal
fields.description: Order subtotal before tax and freight. Computed as the sum of SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal for all lines on this order.

fields.name: TaxAmt
fields.description: Total tax amount charged on the order, calculated based on the shipping address state/province tax rate.

fields.name: Freight
fields.description: Shipping and handling charge for the order, calculated from the selected ShipMethod rates and order weight.

fields.name: TotalDue
fields.description: Total amount due from the customer. Computed as SubTotal + TaxAmt + Freight.

fields.name: Comment
fields.description: Free-text sales representative notes or customer-facing comments attached to the order. Maximum 128 characters. Nullable.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SalesOrderDetail.description: Individual product line items within a sales order, each with ordered quantity, unit price, unit price discount (from SpecialOffer), and calculated line total

fields.name: SalesOrderID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID. Identifies the order this line belongs to.

fields.name: SalesOrderDetailID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying this line item within the order.

fields.name: CarrierTrackingNumber
fields.description: Shipment tracking number provided by the shipping carrier (e.g., UPS, FedEx) after the line is dispatched. Nullable until shipped.

fields.name: OrderQty
fields.description: Number of units of the product ordered on this line. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Foreign key to SpecialOfferProduct.ProductID (composite with SpecialOfferID). Identifies the product ordered on this line.

fields.name: SpecialOfferID
fields.description: Foreign key to SpecialOfferProduct.SpecialOfferID. Links to the applied promotion. SpecialOfferID = 1 means no discount (standard price).

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Selling price per unit in USD at the time the order was placed. May differ from the current Product.ListPrice if a promotion was active.

fields.name: UnitPriceDiscount
fields.description: Discount fraction applied to UnitPrice for this line (e.g., 0.10 = 10% off). Derived from the linked SpecialOffer.DiscountPct.

fields.name: LineTotal
fields.description: Computed line subtotal: UnitPrice * (1 - UnitPriceDiscount) * OrderQty. Represents the amount billed for this line before tax and freight.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason.description: Cross-reference table capturing one or more sales reasons (e.g., Price, Quality, On Promotion) attributed to each sales order

fields.name: SalesOrderID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID. Identifies the order to which this reason is attributed.

fields.name: SalesReasonID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to SalesReason.SalesReasonID. Identifies the motivation recorded for this order.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

ShoppingCartItem.description: Items added to a customer online shopping cart prior to order submission. Keyed by ShoppingCartID (a string token) and ProductID, with quantity and date added. Abandoned carts can be analysed for cart recovery.

fields.name: ShoppingCartItemID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the cart line item.

fields.name: ShoppingCartID
fields.description: Session-scoped identifier token for the shopping cart (e.g., a GUID or session ID string). Multiple items share the same ShoppingCartID to form a cart. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Number of units of the product the customer has added to the cart. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductID. The product added to the cart.

fields.name: DateCreated
fields.description: Date and time the item was first added to the cart. Used to identify abandoned carts and measure time-to-purchase.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated (e.g., when quantity was changed), maintained automatically by the system.

CountryRegionCurrency.description: Cross-reference lookup mapping ISO country/region codes to their primary ISO currency code

fields.name: CountryRegionCode
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. ISO 3166-1 country/region code. Foreign key to CountryRegion.CountryRegionCode.

fields.name: CurrencyCode
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. ISO 4217 currency code that is the primary currency for this country or region. Foreign key to Currency.CurrencyCode.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SalesTaxRate.description: Tax rates applied by state or province, used to calculate the TaxAmt on sales orders. TaxType: 1=Tax applicable on goods, 2=Tax applicable on freight, 3=Tax applicable on all sales.

fields.name: SalesTaxRateID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the tax rate record.

fields.name: StateProvinceID
fields.description: Foreign key to StateProvince.StateProvinceID. Identifies the state or province to which this tax rate applies.

fields.name: TaxType
fields.description: Indicates what the tax applies to. 1 = Tax on retail (goods) transactions only. 2 = Tax on freight only. 3 = Tax on all sales transactions (both goods and freight).

fields.name: TaxRate
fields.description: Percentage tax rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 = 7%). Multiplied against the applicable order total to calculate TaxAmt.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Descriptive label for this tax rate (e.g., Canadian GST, Washington State Tax). Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing small integer uniquely identifying the scrap reason.

fields.name: Name

fields.name: GroupName

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

Shift.description: Work shift definitions for manufacturing and warehouse personnel (Day, Evening, Night) with start and end times

fields.name: ShiftID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing small integer uniquely identifying the shift.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Shift name (Day, Evening, Night). Unique within the table.

fields.name: StartTime
fields.description: Scheduled start time for this shift (e.g., 07:00:00 for the day shift).

fields.name: EndTime
fields.description: Scheduled end time for this shift (e.g., 15:00:00 for the day shift, 23:00:00 for the evening shift).

fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to HumanResources.Employee.BusinessEntityID. Identifies the employee.

fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Date on which this pay rate took effect. Combined with BusinessEntityID to uniquely identify each pay record.

fields.description: Hourly pay rate for the employee in USD, effective from RateChangeDate. Used to calculate payroll and labour cost allocations.

fields.name: PayFrequency

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

BusinessEntityContact.description: Cross-reference table linking business entities (stores, vendors) to their contact persons, capturing the contact type role (e.g., Purchasing Manager, Technical Supervisor)

fields.description: Legal company name of the vendor (e.g., Australia Bike Retailer, Bike World). Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: CreditRating
fields.description: Vendor credit quality rating. 1 = Superior, 2 = Excellent, 3 = Above Average, 4 = Average, 5 = Below Average. Influences purchasing decisions and payment terms.

fields.name: PreferredVendorStatus
fields.description: 0 = Do not use unless no alternative vendor is available. 1 = Preferred vendor for the products they supply; use over non-preferred alternatives.

fields.name: ActiveFlag

fields.name: PurchasingWebServiceURL

ProductVendor.description: Cross-reference table mapping products to the vendors who supply them, including min/max order quantities, standard price, last receipt cost and date, and lead time in days

fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the component or raw material being sourced.

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to Vendor.BusinessEntityID. Identifies the vendor supplying this product.

fields.name: AverageLeadTime
fields.description: Average number of calendar days between raising a purchase order and receiving the product from this vendor. Used for reorder point calculations.

fields.name: StandardPrice
fields.description: Vendor's standard quoted price per unit in USD. Used as the baseline cost on new purchase orders.

fields.name: LastReceiptCost

fields.name: OnOrderQty
fields.description: Current quantity on open purchase orders with this vendor for this product. Nullable if no orders are outstanding.

fields.name: UnitMeasureCode

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

fields.name: PurchaseOrderID

fields.name: RevisionNumber
fields.description: Incremental counter tracking the number of changes made to this purchase order since creation.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Current purchase order lifecycle status. 1 = Pending (not yet approved). 2 = Approved. 3 = Rejected. 4 = Complete (all items received).

fields.name: OrderDate

fields.name: ShipDate
fields.description: Expected date on which the vendor will ship the order. Nullable until confirmed.

fields.name: SubTotal
fields.description: Order subtotal before tax and freight. Computed as the sum of PurchaseOrderDetail.LineTotal for all lines on this order.

fields.name: TaxAmt
fields.description: Total tax charged by the vendor on this purchase order, in USD.

fields.name: Freight
fields.description: Shipping and freight charge for the purchase order, in USD.

fields.name: TotalDue
fields.description: Total amount owed to the vendor. Computed as SubTotal + TaxAmt + Freight.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

PurchaseOrderDetail.description: Individual product line items within a purchase order, recording ordered quantity, unit price, received quantity, rejected quantity, and due date

fields.name: PurchaseOrderID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to PurchaseOrderHeader.PurchaseOrderID. Identifies the purchase order this line belongs to.

fields.name: PurchaseOrderDetailID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying this line item within the purchase order.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: Date by which the ordered quantity must be received from the vendor to meet production schedules.

fields.name: OrderQty
fields.description: Number of units of the product ordered on this line.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the component or raw material being ordered.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Vendor's agreed price per unit in USD for this purchase order line.

fields.name: LineTotal

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

fields.description: Original file name for the large-format image (e.g., racer02_black_f.gif). Maximum 50 characters.

ProductProductPhoto.description: Cross-reference table linking products to their product photos. The Primary flag (bit) marks the default display image for a product in the storefront gallery.

TransactionHistory.description: Inventory transaction history for the current year, recording every work order, sales order, and purchase order movement per product. TransactionType: W=Work Order, S=Sales Order, P=Purchase Order.

fields.description: Identifier of the source document that triggered this transaction: a WorkOrderID, SalesOrderID, or PurchaseOrderID depending on TransactionType.

fields.name: ReferenceOrderLineID
fields.description: Line item number within the source order document (e.g., SalesOrderDetailID or PurchaseOrderDetailID). 0 for work order transactions.

fields.name: TransactionDate
fields.description: Date and time the inventory movement was recorded.

fields.name: TransactionType
fields.description: Single-character code indicating the type of transaction: W = Work Order (production output/consumption), S = Sales Order (outbound sale), P = Purchase Order (inbound receipt).

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Number of units involved in the transaction. Positive for receipts (P, W production), negative for issues (S, W consumption).

fields.name: ActualCost
fields.description: Actual unit cost in USD at the time of the transaction, multiplied by Quantity to give the total value of the movement.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

TransactionHistoryArchive.description: Archived product inventory transaction records for previous years. Identical structure to TransactionHistory; older records are periodically moved here to keep the active table small.

fields.name: TransactionID
fields.description: Primary key. Preserves the original TransactionID from TransactionHistory when the record was archived.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductID. The product involved in the archived inventory transaction.

fields.name: ReferenceOrderID
fields.description: Identifier of the source order document (work order, sales order, or purchase order) that triggered this transaction.

fields.name: ReferenceOrderLineID
fields.description: Line number within the source order. 0 for work order transactions.

fields.name: TransactionDate
fields.description: Date and time the original inventory movement was recorded.

fields.name: TransactionType
fields.description: W = Work Order, S = Sales Order, P = Purchase Order. Matches the original transaction type from TransactionHistory.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Number of units involved in the archived transaction.

fields.name: ActualCost
fields.description: Actual unit cost in USD at the time of the original transaction.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

WorkOrder.description: Manufacturing work orders tracking the production of products, with planned and actual quantities, scheduled start and end dates, actual start and end dates, and scrap quantity with reason

fields.name: WorkOrderID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the work order.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the finished good or sub-component being produced.

fields.name: OrderQty
fields.description: Target quantity of the product to manufacture on this work order.

fields.name: StockedQty
fields.description: Quantity of finished units added to inventory. Computed as OrderQty - ScrappedQty.

fields.name: ScrappedQty
fields.description: Number of units that failed quality inspection and were scrapped during production.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Date and time production actually began on this work order.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Date and time production was completed or cancelled. Nullable if the work order is still open.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: Scheduled completion date by which the finished quantity must be ready for inventory.

fields.name: ScrapReasonID
fields.description: Foreign key to ScrapReason.ScrapReasonID. Identifies the reason for any scrapped units. Nullable when ScrappedQty = 0.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

WorkOrderRouting.description: Manufacturing routing information per work order operation, recording the Location, operation sequence, scheduled and actual start/end times, planned and actual resource hours, and actual costs

fields.name: WorkOrderID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to WorkOrder.WorkOrderID. Identifies the work order this routing step belongs to.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Denormalised from the work order for quick access.

fields.name: OperationSequence
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Sequential step number within the work order routing (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Determines the order in which manufacturing operations are performed.

fields.name: LocationID
fields.description: Foreign key to Location.LocationID. Work center where this operation step is performed.

fields.name: ScheduledStartDate
fields.description: Planned start date and time for this manufacturing operation step, derived from the work order schedule.

fields.name: ScheduledEndDate
fields.description: Planned completion date and time for this operation step.

fields.name: ActualStartDate
fields.description: Actual date and time the operation step began. Nullable until work commences.

fields.name: ActualEndDate
fields.description: Actual date and time the operation step was completed. Nullable until complete.

fields.name: ActualResourceHrs
fields.description: Actual machine or labour hours consumed at this work center for this operation step. Used to calculate actual production costs.

fields.name: PlannedCost
fields.description: Budgeted cost for this operation step in USD, based on Location.CostRate and estimated resource hours.

fields.name: ActualCost
fields.description: Actual cost incurred for this operation step in USD, based on ActualResourceHrs and the location cost rate.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SalesPersonQuotaHistory.description: Quarterly sales quota history for each sales representative, used for performance benchmarking and commission calculation

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to SalesPerson.BusinessEntityID. Identifies the sales representative.

fields.name: QuotaDate
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Start date of the quarter for which this sales quota was set (typically January, April, July, or October).

fields.name: SalesQuota
fields.description: Target sales revenue in USD assigned to the sales person for the quota period starting on QuotaDate.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

SalesTerritoryHistory.description: History of sales territory assignments for each sales person, with StartDate and EndDate tracking geographic responsibility changes over time

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to SalesPerson.BusinessEntityID. Identifies the sales person whose territory assignment is recorded.

fields.name: TerritoryID
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to SalesTerritory.TerritoryID. Identifies the territory the sales person was responsible for.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Part of composite primary key. Date on which the sales person took responsibility for this territory.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Date on which the sales person's responsibility for this territory ended. NULL means this is the current active territory assignment.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

JobCandidate.description: Résumés and application records for job candidates submitted to Human Resources, stored as structured XML. EmployeeID is populated after a candidate is hired.

fields.name: JobCandidateID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the job candidate application.

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: Foreign key to HumanResources.Employee.BusinessEntityID. Populated if the candidate was subsequently hired as an employee. Nullable for external applicants not yet hired.

fields.name: Resume
fields.description: Candidate's résumé stored as structured XML, following a standard Adventure Works HR schema. Contains education history, employment history, skills, references, and personal statement.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

ProductReview.description: Customer product reviews with 1–5 star ratings and free-text comments. AI-enhanced: CommentsEmbedding (VECTOR(1536), text-embedding-3-small) enables semantic review search. Additional demo fields: HelpfulVotes (upvote counter), UserID (links reviewer to Person.Person for authenticated reviews), IsModerated (bit flag for staff content moderation).

fields.name: ProductReviewID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the product review.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the product being reviewed.

fields.name: ReviewerName
fields.description: Display name of the reviewer as entered at submission. Maximum 50 characters. For authenticated reviews this may be derived from the linked Person record.

fields.name: ReviewDate
fields.description: Date and time the review was submitted. Defaults to the current date/time at insertion.

fields.name: EmailAddress
fields.description: Email address provided by the reviewer at submission. Not displayed publicly. Used for follow-up moderation communications. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: Rating
fields.description: Numeric star rating given by the reviewer on a scale of 1 (worst) to 5 (best). Used to compute AverageRating on the HelpMeChoose view.

fields.name: Comments
fields.description: Free-text review body written by the customer. Maximum 3850 characters. Displayed on the product detail page alongside the star rating.

fields.name: CommentsEmbedding
fields.description: 1536-dimensional vector embedding of the Comments text, generated using Azure OpenAI text-embedding-3-small. Enables semantic review search, sentiment clustering, and AI-powered review summarisation.

fields.name: HelpfulVotes
fields.description: Running count of upvotes from other customers who found this review helpful. Incremented via the HelpfulVote Azure Function endpoint.

fields.name: UserID
fields.description: Foreign key to Person.BusinessEntityID. Links this review to an authenticated customer account. Nullable for guest (unauthenticated) reviews.

fields.name: IsModerated
fields.description: 0 = Review has not yet been reviewed by staff. 1 = Review has been reviewed and approved for public display by a staff moderator.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

ProductReviewReply.description: Staff or automated replies to customer product reviews. Captures the reply text (up to 3850 chars), the author name (RepliedBy, defaults to 'AdventureWorks Team'), and the reply date. One or more replies can be attached to a single review.

fields.name: ProductReviewReplyID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the reply record.

fields.name: ProductReviewID
fields.description: Foreign key to ProductReview.ProductReviewID. Identifies the customer review that this reply responds to.

fields.name: ReplyText
fields.description: Text body of the staff reply. Maximum 3850 characters. Displayed beneath the customer review on the product detail page.

fields.name: RepliedBy
fields.description: Display name of the person or team who authored the reply (e.g., AdventureWorks Team, Customer Success). Defaults to 'AdventureWorks Team'. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: ReplyDate
fields.description: Date and time the reply was posted. Defaults to the current date/time at insertion.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

BillOfMaterials.description: Bill of materials defining which component products (ComponentID) are required to assemble a parent product (ProductAssemblyID), with required quantity, unit of measure, and effective date range. NULL ProductAssemblyID means a standalone (top-level) component.

fields.name: BillOfMaterialsID
fields.description: Primary key. Auto-incrementing integer uniquely identifying the bill of materials line.

fields.name: ProductAssemblyID
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the parent finished good or sub-assembly that requires this component. NULL indicates that the component is a top-level stand-alone item with no parent assembly.

fields.name: ComponentID
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the component or raw material required by the assembly.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Date on which this component requirement became effective for the assembly. Together with EndDate forms the validity window.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Date on which this component was removed from the bill of materials. NULL means this requirement is currently active.

fields.name: UnitMeasureCode
fields.description: Unit of measure for the PerAssemblyQty value (e.g., EA, LB, IN). Foreign key to UnitMeasure.UnitMeasureCode.

fields.name: BOMLevel
fields.description: Depth of this component in the product structure hierarchy. 0 = top-level finished good; higher numbers indicate deeper sub-assemblies.

fields.name: PerAssemblyQty
fields.description: Quantity of ComponentID required to produce one unit of ProductAssemblyID. Expressed in the unit given by UnitMeasureCode.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Date and time the record was last updated, maintained automatically by the system.

Employee.description: Read-only view of Adventure Works Cycles employees for API access. Based on HumanResources.Employee but excludes the hierarchyid columns (OrganizationNode, OrganizationLevel) which are not supported by Data API Builder. Includes identity, job title, employment dates, leave balances, and current status.

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: Primary key. Foreign key to BusinessEntity.BusinessEntityID. Unique identifier shared across all person, vendor, and store records.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Optional courtesy title prefix (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.). Maximum 8 characters.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: Employee's given (first) name. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Employee's middle name or initial. Optional. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Employee's family (last) name. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: Suffix
fields.description: Optional generational or professional name suffix (e.g., Jr., Sr., III). Maximum 10 characters.

fields.name: JobTitle
fields.description: Employee's official job title (e.g., Production Supervisor, Purchasing Manager, Design Engineer). Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: PhoneNumber
fields.description: Employee's primary contact telephone number from PersonPhone. Maximum 25 characters.

fields.name: PhoneNumberType
fields.description: Type of the primary phone number (Cell, Home, Work). Sourced from PhoneNumberType.Name.

fields.name: EmailAddress
fields.description: Employee's primary email address from Person.EmailAddress. Maximum 50 characters.

fields.name: EmailPromotion
fields.description: Marketing opt-in level inherited from Person.EmailPromotion. 0 = No promotional emails, 1 = Adventure Works only, 2 = Third-party opt-in.

fields.name: AddressLine1
fields.description: First line of the employee's home address (street number and name). Maximum 60 characters.

fields.name: AddressLine2
fields.description: Second address line (suite, apartment, floor). Optional. Maximum 60 characters.

fields.name: City
fields.description: City portion of the employee's home address. Maximum 30 characters.

fields.name: StateProvinceName
fields.description: Full state or province name from StateProvince.Name (e.g., Washington, Ontario).

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description: Postal or ZIP code for the employee's home address. Maximum 15 characters.

fields.name: CountryRegionName
fields.description: Full country or region name from CountryRegion.Name (e.g., United States, Canada).

fields.name: AdditionalContactInfo
fields.description: Supplementary contact information stored as XML (e.g., emergency contacts, alternative phone numbers).

fields.name: NationalIDNumber
fields.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number for US employees). Maximum 15 characters. Sensitive PII — restrict access in production.

fields.name: LoginID
fields.description: Network login identifier for this employee (e.g., adventure-works\ken0). Used for Active Directory / Entra ID authentication. Maximum 256 characters.

fields.name: BirthDate
fields.description: Employee's date of birth. Sensitive PII — restrict access in production.

fields.name: MaritalStatus
fields.description: Single-character marital status code: M = Married, S = Single.

fields.name: Gender
fields.description: Single-character gender code: M = Male, F = Female.

fields.name: HireDate
fields.description: Date on which the employee was first hired by Adventure Works Cycles.

fields.name: SalariedFlag
fields.description: 0 = Hourly worker, subject to overtime rules. 1 = Salaried employee, exempt from overtime.

fields.name: VacationHours
fields.description: Number of accrued paid vacation hours the employee is currently entitled to use.

fields.name: SickLeaveHours
fields.description: Number of accrued paid sick leave hours the employee is currently entitled to use.

fields.name: CurrentFlag
fields.description: 0 = Employee is no longer active (terminated or on indefinite leave). 1 = Employee is currently active.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: ROWGUIDCOL uniquely identifying the record. Used for merge replication.

HelpMeChoose.description: Comprehensive read-only view for the Help Me Choose AI agent. Flattens finished-goods product attributes (ProductID, ProductName, ProductDescription, Color, Size, ProductLine, Style), culture-specific Category and Subcategory names, IsInStock (derived from ProductInventory), ListPrice, and AverageRating/ReviewCount (aggregated from ProductReview) — one row per ProductID + CultureID combination.

fields.name: CultureID
fields.description: Part of composite key. Culture/language code for this row (e.g., en, fr, ar). All text fields (ProductName, ProductDescription, Category, Subcategory) are in this language.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Part of composite key. Foreign key to Product.ProductID. Identifies the finished good product.

fields.name: ProductName
fields.description: Culture-specific translated product name from ProductName.Name for the row's CultureID (e.g., Mountain-100 Silver, 38 in English; the AI-translated equivalent in other languages).

fields.name: ProductDescription
fields.description: Culture-specific product description text from ProductDescription.Description. Up to 2000 characters of AI-enhanced marketing and technical content in the row's language.

fields.name: Color
fields.description: AI-generated descriptive colour name for the product (e.g., Gloss Midnight Black, Brushed Aluminium Silver). Inherited from Product.Color, extended to 256 characters. Nullable for colourless components.

fields.name: Size
fields.description: Product size designator (e.g., S, M, L, 38, 42, 58). Nullable for products without a size dimension.

fields.name: ProductLine
fields.description: Two-character product line: R = Road, M = Mountain, T = Touring, S = Standard. Useful for filtering products by intended use.

fields.name: Style
fields.description: Two-character fit style: W = Womens, M = Mens, U = Universal. Nullable for non-apparel products.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Top-level category name localised for CultureID (e.g., Bikes, Components, Clothing, Accessories in English; translated in other cultures).

fields.name: Subcategory
fields.description: Product subcategory name localised for CultureID (e.g., Mountain Bikes, Helmets, Jerseys). Provides a second level of filtering for AI product recommendations.

fields.name: IsInStock
fields.description: 1 if the product has at least one unit of on-hand inventory across all locations; 0 if out of stock. Derived from ProductInventory.Quantity.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description: Current retail selling price in USD. 0.00 indicates the product is not currently for sale.

fields.name: AverageRating
fields.description: Mean star rating across all submitted reviews for this product (1.0–5.0). Computed from ProductReview.Rating. Nullable if no reviews exist.

fields.name: ReviewCount
fields.description: Total number of customer reviews submitted for this product. 0 if no reviews have been written.
